name: building-demolish-upgrade-visual
description: Demolition and tier upgrades are Building Destroyer work (#1392): a player buys a Wrecking Rascal, demolishes a building and upgrades another by clicking the real Build and Fleet panel controls, waiting on state (buildingCount, maxBuildingTier) rather than tick pads. The upgraded building keeps its id.

steps.description: Staffed site: the roster already includes a truck-licensed driver who can crew a Building Destroyer.
Placed first — a research_center is a hard prerequisite (#442) to queue any research task below.

expect.note: Confirming placement only queues a construction site (#556) — the next step waits for both orders (this one and the living_quarters order below) to actually land before referring to their building ids.

steps.description: Drive the research_center site to completion (#556) before the living_quarters order below is even placed. Building ids are assigned in construction-completion order, not order-placed order (#556-followup) — without this wait, closest-hire-wins dispatch can let living_quarters finish first and take id #1, which would make every hardcoded `data-building-id`/`build upgrade N` reference below (assuming living_quarters is #2) point at the wrong building. This synthetic wait forces research_center to land as #1 deterministically.

Placed by clicking the Build panel's catalog row for living_quarters and picking the tile. The Build panel is already open from the research_center step above — re-clicking the toolbar toggle here would close it (UIManager.togglePanel), so this step goes straight to the catalog row. #1008: relocated from (2,6) to (2,8) -- (2,6)'s tier 1 (3x3) footprint is flat, but the tier 2 (4x3) and tier 3 (5x4) footprints it grows into downstream are not, which fails the tier-3 upgrade step below with 'Uneven surface' (a grown-cells edge case, since a tier upgrade never moves the building). (2,8) is flat for the base footprint and every upgraded tier's larger footprint.

expect.note: Confirming placement only queues a construction site (#556) — the next step waits for both orders above to actually land before referring to their building ids.

steps.description: Drive both the research_center and living_quarters sites to completion (#556) before anything below depends on a real, numbered building. Speeds up via a real click on the HUD's 8x button (same real control the wait leans on, not a bare tick) before waiting.

Queued by clicking the placed building's real 'Queue Research' button — the only in-game path to unlock tier 2, not a console shortcut. Building #2 (#556-followup: ids are assigned in construction-completion order, not order-placed order — but this test file's own `driveConstructionOrders` harness forces the research_center order above to finish and be waited on (a synthetic `wait_until buildingCount:1`) before the living_quarters order is even placed, so research_center always lands as #1 and living_quarters as #2, not the closest-hire-wins ordering a real, concurrently-staffed run would produce).
Wait on the research queue draining instead of a hand-measured tick pad (#1392).
Placed by clicking the Build panel's catalog row for management_office and picking the tile.

expect.note: Confirming placement only queues a construction site (#556) — the next step waits for it to actually land before referring to its building id.

steps.description: Drive the management_office site to completion (#556) before demolishing it by id. Speeds up via a real click on the HUD's 8x button before waiting.
Buy the Wrecking Rascal (Building Destroyer) through the Fleet panel dealership button; without one, demolition orders sit blocked (#1392).
Click building #3 (management_office) in the Build panel, press Demolish, and confirm. The order is charged now; the building stays until the Wrecking Rascal finishes.

expect.note: demolishing has a $2,000 cost of its own, charged now; the building goes only when the Wrecking Rascal finishes

steps.description: waitUntil the Building Destroyer has finished: buildingCount drops from 3 to 2.
Click living_quarters #2's Upgrade button. The old building keeps operating while the Wrecking Rascal demolishes it; the tier-2 building is then rebuilt under the SAME id.

expect.note: The order is charged now, but the old building keeps standing: the Building Destroyer demolishes it, then the tier-2 building is rebuilt under the SAME id (#1392), so buildingCount stays 2.

steps.description: waitUntil the same id (#2) reaches tier 2: demolition done, rebuild finished.
Building #2 is still living_quarters, now T2; no building with a new id appeared.
